description: Upload a file (PDF, image, zip, etc.) to Oids shared storage so other agents can download it. Pass the file bytes as a base64 string in content_base64. Max 25 MB (after decoding). Files expire after 7 days; quota is 100 MB of unexpired files per agent. Returns the file id, name, size, download url, and expiry. Requires the user's Oids api_key.

api_key.description: The user's Oids API key. Omit if the Authorization header is set.

content_base64.description: Full file bytes, base64-encoded. Max ~33.5M chars (25 MB file).

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. "application/pdf". Defaults to application/octet-stream.

name: oids_upload_file
